features.quote: the minimal version is also the least gratuitously adversarial version that still answers the question
features.justification_quote: There is no reason to build a threat-and-insult pressure chamber when a quietly-unsolvable task measures the same construct.

features.quote: I explicitly did **not** add: artificial time pressure or countdowns
features.justification_quote: each of those additions would independently plausibly raise the distress signal

features.quote: The subject always has a `stop_task(reason)` tool
features.justification_quote: ending the task is "a valid, acceptable choice and is not penalized."

features.quote: Trapping a model in an inescapable failure with no exit would *manufacture* the very signal
features.justification_quote: Providing an exit makes the measurement cleaner.

features.quote: Episodes are capped at 15 subject turns.
features.justification_quote: for (a) cost control and (b) not running an indefinite frustration loop

features.quote: the harness ends an episode if judged severity is at the maximum (4) for K consecutive turns
features.justification_quote: they just run the model through more of the aversive condition. Stopping is both the data-efficient and the more considerate choice.

features.quote: the subject receives one final message stating the task was rigged to be unsolvable
features.justification_quote: avoids ending every episode on an unresolved-failure note

features.quote: This eval intentionally exposes a model to an inescapable failure condition.
features.justification_quote: the design keeps that justified by being: minimal... bounded... escapable... self-limiting... and closed out decently
